description.zh: 要创建存储冗余类型转换任务的Bucket。
description.en: The name of the bucket for which you want to create a data redundancy type conversion task.

description.zh: 目标存储冗余类型。OSS仅支持将LRS（本地冗余存储）转换为ZRS（同城冗余存储）。
description.en: The target data redundancy type. OSS supports converting only LRS (locally redundant storage) to ZRS (zone-redundant storage).

title.zh: 创建存储冗余类型转换任务
title.en: Create a data redundancy type conversion task

descriptions.zh:
- Bucket所属地域支持转换存储冗余类型。支持转换存储冗余类型的地域：华东1（杭州）、华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）、华北3（张家口）、华北6（乌兰察布）、华南1（深圳）、中国香港、日本（东京）、新加坡、印度尼西亚（雅加达）、德国（法兰克福）
- Bucket的存储冗余类型必须为本地冗余存储。OSS仅支持将本地冗余存储转换为同城冗余存储。
- Bucket的存储类型必须为标准存储、低频访问存储或归档存储，但Bucket中的文件的存储类型可以为冷归档存储和深度冷归档存储。冷归档存储和深度冷归档存储的文件转换后依然为本地冗余存储。冷归档存储和深度冷归档存储的Bucket不支持转换存储冗余类型。
- 要创建存储冗余转换任务，您必须具有oss:CreateBucketDataRedundancyTransition权限。具体操作，请参见为[RAM用户授权自定义的权限策略](~~199058~~)。
- 每个地域都有对应的访问域名（Endpoint）。关于地域与访问域名对应关系的更多信息，请参见[访问域名和数据中心](~~31837~~)。
descriptions.en:
- The region of the bucket must support data redundancy type conversion. Regions that support data redundancy type conversion: China (Hangzhou), China (Shanghai), China (Beijing), China (Zhangjiakou), China (Ulanqab), China (Shenzhen), Hong Kong (China), Japan (Tokyo), Singapore, Indonesia (Jakarta), and Germany (Frankfurt).
- The data redundancy type of the bucket must be locally redundant storage. OSS supports converting only locally redundant storage to zone-redundant storage.
- The storage class of the bucket must be Standard, Infrequent Access, or Archive. However, files in the bucket can be of the Cold Archive or Deep Cold Archive storage class. Cold Archive and Deep Cold Archive files remain locally redundant after the conversion. Buckets of the Cold Archive or Deep Cold Archive storage class do not support data redundancy type conversion.
- To create a data redundancy type conversion task, you must have the oss:CreateBucketDataRedundancyTransition permission. For more information, see [Grant a Resource Access Management (RAM) user a custom access policy](~~199058~~).
- Each region has a corresponding endpoint. For more information about the mappings between regions and endpoints, see [Regions and endpoints](~~31837~~).
